searchText: Okay I feel like I confuse myself everytime I try to understand the patricia tree and how that links to mining. I kind of get this (https://eth.wiki/fundamentals/patricia-tree), but when I look at this https://docs.ethhub.io/using-ethereum/mining/ I get confused on how the three roots get connected how is state mapped to transaction and receipt if in different trees, and where do logs go 🤣 any help appreciated, thanks 🙂 also a more basic question, when people say "distributed ledger" are the referring to the whole block, or just one of the three roots? They aren't linked together at all. Logs are in the receipts. A distributed ledger is the general idea of a lockstep ledger with an incredibly high replication factor.
